title: Ensure previous approvals are dismissed when new changes are pushed
titleZh: 源分支更新后重置已有审批
description: Without this, an author can collect approvals on a harmless diff and then push anything they like to the same branch before merging. The approval no longer refers to the code that ships.
remediation: Repository settings -> Pull requests: enable "Unapprove automatically on new changes" (labelled "Reset approvals when the source branch is modified" on some versions). Set it at Project settings -> Pull requests to apply it project-wide.
remediationZh: 仓库设置 -> Pull requests：启用「Unapprove automatically on new changes」（部分版本显示为「源分支变更时重置审批」）。在 项目设置 -> Pull requests 配置可覆盖整个项目。
